title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader
summary_full: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.
